issues.issue: Whether the claimants rebutted the presumption of state protection in Brazil.
issues.applicant_position: Partner's abuse and threats were reported to police, but police did not act; protection was not available.
issues.result_text: Claimants failed to rebut presumption of state protection and did not take all reasonable steps.

issues.issue: Whether the minor claimant's claim succeeds on family membership alone.
issues.result_text: Minor claimant's claim rests only on the mother's claim and must also fail.
